name: @fitme/library-bundle
description: The Library bundles: the library.json fitme-exercises publishes (its version 1 schema, shared by the Library API build), the version 2 schema fitme-library publishes the in-memory Library over it, its source and the per-instance Library loaded from it (ADR 0022), and the Library index the writers check Exercise slugs and pick Covers against (ADR 0018).
